how_to_edit: Bestiary entries for the Codex (M) → Bestiary tab. order: the list order. Each entry: name, category (Boss, Guardian, Elite and Mini Boss show as bosses), dungeon (Verdant Forest, Stone Crypt or Balor's Hell; the bestiary's filter tabs), description, habitat, behavior (how it fights), tactics (how to beat it), traits. An entry is unlocked by defeating that enemy once. Drops come from data/materials.json.

wolf_vanguard.name: Vanguard Wolf
wolf_vanguard.description: The front line of a corrupted hunting pack.
wolf_vanguard.behavior: Rushes detected prey relentlessly and bites with little hesitation.
wolf_vanguard.tactics: Stand your ground and swing as it arrives: it runs straight in. Finish it before the rest of the pack closes.

wolf_lurker.name: Lurker Wolf
wolf_lurker.description: A patient ambusher whose outline fades into the undergrowth.
wolf_lurker.behavior: Waits motionless until prey approaches, then lunges from concealment.
wolf_lurker.tactics: Watch the brush for a faint outline. Step aside when it lunges, then punish the recovery.

wolf_charger.name: Charger Wolf
wolf_charger.description: A heavy wolf bred for devastating straight-line assaults.
wolf_charger.behavior: Telegraphs a target point before charging through it at high speed.
wolf_charger.tactics: When it marks a line, step off it. The charge carries it past you: hit it while it skids to a stop.

wolf_hunter.name: Hunter Wolf
wolf_hunter.description: A tireless tracker able to find prey anywhere in the Heartwood.
wolf_hunter.behavior: Tracks globally and uses crippling bites that slow movement.
wolf_hunter.tactics: Its bite slows you, so don't trade blows. Dash out, let it follow, and strike as it comes in.

wolf_howler.name: Howler Wolf
wolf_howler.description: A pack mystic whose voice knits corrupted flesh back together.
wolf_howler.behavior: Keeps its distance and heals nearby wounded wolves with a telegraphed howl.
wolf_howler.tactics: Kill it first. It hangs back and heals the pack with a long howl: rush it while it howls.

feral_wolf.name: Feral Wolf
feral_wolf.description: A pack hunter twisted by the Verdant Forest's restless magic.
feral_wolf.behavior: Closes distance quickly and worries isolated prey.
feral_wolf.tactics: Fast but fragile. Keep swinging as it comes in and keep your back clear.

thornback_boar.name: Thornback Boar
thornback_boar.description: A massive wild boar armored by bark plates and living thorn-vines.
thornback_boar.behavior: Tramples directly toward intruders and finishes its rush with a violent tusk gore.
thornback_boar.tactics: Sidestep the rush; the gore at the end leaves it open. Don't stand between it and a wall.

heartwood_colossus.name: The Heartwood Colossus
heartwood_colossus.description: The oldest tree in the Verdant Forest, hollowed by the Dark Druid's corruption until something vast woke inside it.
heartwood_colossus.habitat: Rooted at the heart of its own clearing
heartwood_colossus.behavior: Never moves. Rains spores, slams root-fists onto marked ground and spins thorns; after each attack its heart or a fallen fist lies open to be struck.
heartwood_colossus.tactics: It never moves. Stay off the marked ground, then hit its open heart or a fallen fist after each attack.

sporeling.name: Sporeling
sporeling.description: Knee-high mushrooms that sleep in clusters among the ordinary caps of the forest floor.
sporeling.behavior: Lie dormant until disturbed, wake every sporeling nearby, then swarm and hop in to nibble.
sporeling.tactics: Weak alone, dangerous in a swarm. Back up so they come in a line, and sweep them with wide swings.

bandit_cutthroat.name: Kobold Cutthroat
bandit_cutthroat.description: A kobold road-thief who has graduated from purses to throats.
bandit_cutthroat.behavior: Circles its prey out of reach, then crouches and lunges through them with a dagger slash.
bandit_cutthroat.tactics: It circles out of reach. When it crouches, dodge through the lunge and hit it from behind.

bandit_knifethrower.name: Kobold Knife-Thrower
bandit_knifethrower.description: Keeps a bandolier of stolen kitchen knives and very good aim.
bandit_knifethrower.habitat: Behind its friends, on forest trails
bandit_knifethrower.behavior: Backs away from anyone who gets close and throws spinning knives; deeper in, it throws three at once.
bandit_knifethrower.tactics: Close the gap: it backs away and throws. Move sideways to the knives, never straight at them.

spore_beast.name: Spore Beast
spore_beast.description: A swollen fungal brute that spreads slowing spores as it advances.
spore_beast.behavior: Absorbs punishment and controls nearby ground.
spore_beast.tactics: Slow and tough. Stay out of its spore ground and chip at it from the edge.

briar_guardian.name: Briar Guardian
briar_guardian.description: A knot of roots and thorned branches animated by the Heartwood's corruption.
briar_guardian.behavior: Scuttles after prey before unfurling long branches in a close-range thorn lash.
briar_guardian.tactics: Keep out of branch reach until it lashes, then step in and strike before it unfurls again.

ice_mage.name: Rime Cultivator
ice_mage.description: A cold-channeling adept surrounded by frostbitten leaves.
ice_mage.behavior: Uses chilling attacks to slow pursuit and maintain distance.
ice_mage.tactics: Its chill slows you. Close in quickly between casts; it's frail up close.

dark_druid.name: The Dark Druid, Wolfmaster
dark_druid.description: The will behind the Forest's corruption, commanding twisted hunting packs through root and howl.
dark_druid.behavior: Roots prey, summons specialized wolf packs, and empowers its wounded servants as the battle escalates.
dark_druid.tactics: Break free of roots by moving, thin the wolves it calls, then pressure the druid while its pack is down.

infernal_caster.name: Infernal Caster
infernal_caster.description: A horned adept that braids flame into dense projectile fans.
infernal_caster.behavior: Maintains range and fires predictive five-shot spreads.
infernal_caster.tactics: Its five-shot spread aims where you're going. Change direction, then close in.

rift_stalker.name: Rift Stalker
rift_stalker.description: A fiend that steps through hot fractures in reality.
rift_stalker.behavior: Teleports around its target and emerges inside a radial volley.
rift_stalker.tactics: When it vanishes, keep moving: it reappears inside a ring of shots. Hit it the moment it lands.

hellcharger.name: Hellcharger
hellcharger.description: An iron-plated beast whose hooves ignite the floor.
hellcharger.behavior: Telegraphs a charge and leaves a damaging trail of fire.
hellcharger.tactics: Step off the charge line and away from its fire trail. Strike its flank as it stops.

cinder_bomber.name: Cinder Bomber
cinder_bomber.description: A swollen cinder fiend carrying an unstable furnace-heart.
cinder_bomber.behavior: Marks predicted impact points, then erupts them into flame and projectiles.
cinder_bomber.tactics: Leave the marked circles before they erupt, then catch it between throws.

fire_spirit.name: Fire Spirit
fire_spirit.description: A brief and furious soul torn from Balor's flame.
fire_spirit.behavior: Chases prey at high speed and explodes when its fuse expires.
fire_spirit.tactics: It explodes when its fuse runs out. Kill it fast or lead it away from you.

infernal_legate.name: Infernal Legate
infernal_legate.description: Balor's field commander and keeper of condemned spirits.
infernal_legate.behavior: Summons pursuing fire spirits while filling the arena with radial volleys.
infernal_legate.tactics: Clear the fire spirits, slip the gaps in its volleys, then pressure it between summons.

balor.name: Balor
balor.description: The one-eyed sovereign of the infernal circles.
balor.behavior: Alternates dense projectile barrages, fast explosive minions, and large temporary ground hazards.
balor.tactics: Learn its three patterns: thread the barrages, kill the minions, and stay out of the burning ground.

skeleton.name: Risen Skeleton
skeleton.description: Bones of the ordinary dead, stood back up by whatever stirs below.
skeleton.behavior: Shambles straight at the living and hacks with a rusted blade.
skeleton.tactics: Slow and simple. Hit it before it reaches you; it can't keep up with a sidestep.

skeletal_archer.name: Skeletal Archer
skeletal_archer.description: A tomb sentry that never put its bow down.
skeletal_archer.behavior: Keeps its distance and looses aimed arrows; fans of three deeper down.
skeletal_archer.tactics: Weave sideways to its arrows and close in. Deeper down, step between the three-arrow fan.

necromancer.name: Grave Acolyte
necromancer.description: A robed servant of the crypt's master, still muttering the rites.
necromancer.behavior: Marks the ground where you will be, then calls necrotic fire onto it.
necromancer.tactics: It fires where you will be: change direction when the mark appears, then strike while it casts.

soul_wisp.name: Soul Wisp
soul_wisp.description: A loose soul that can't find its way out.
soul_wisp.behavior: Strafes around you firing soul bolts, with rings of slow spirits between.
soul_wisp.tactics: It strafes and fires. Cut across its path, and slip through the gaps in its spirit rings.

crypt_boss.name: The Crypt Lord
crypt_boss.description: The necromancer who holds the stairs between the crypt's floors.
crypt_boss.behavior: Fires fans and rings of souls and calls the dead to fight for it. Stands guard at the stairs on every floor.
crypt_boss.tactics: Stands at the stairs. Thin out the dead it calls, dodge through the gaps in its soul rings, then hit hard.

grave_rat.name: Grave Rat
grave_rat.description: Fat on the dead and not fussy about the living.
grave_rat.habitat: Under bone piles, in nests of three
grave_rat.behavior: Hides beneath the bones until you come close, wakes its nest, then swarms in to bite.
grave_rat.tactics: Bone piles hide nests. Wake them from range and fight them where they must come at you one by one.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: A corpse-eater, quicker than it looks.
ghoul.behavior: Circles just out of reach, then crouches and lunges through you with its claws.
ghoul.tactics: Like the cutthroat: it circles, then crouches and lunges. Dodge through and hit its back.

gravedigger.name: Gravedigger
gravedigger.description: Still digging, centuries on. Throws what it digs up.
gravedigger.behavior: Backs away from anyone close and lobs bones; three at a time deeper down.
gravedigger.tactics: Chase it down; it backs away and lobs bones. Watch for the three-bone throw deeper down.

tomb_guard.name: Tomb Guard
tomb_guard.description: An armoured warden bound to its post with a tower shield.
tomb_guard.behavior: Its shield blocks every hit from the front and it turns slowly. Get behind it, or let it bash: the shield is down for a moment afterwards.
tomb_guard.tactics: The shield blocks from the front. Circle behind it, or bait a bash and strike while the shield is down.

revenant.name: Revenant
revenant.description: A skeleton that doesn't stay down.
revenant.behavior: Collapses into bones when killed and rises again at half health a few seconds later, unless you smash the pile.
revenant.tactics: It rises again from its bones. Smash the pile before it stands back up.

charnel_king.name: Big Skelly Boi
charnel_king.description: A king buried with his whole court, grown into the crypt's deepest hall and half-sunk into its floor.
charnel_king.behavior: Never moves. Sweeps a giant hand across marked lanes, wails rings of souls with a gap to slip through, and rains bones on marked circles. After each attack a hand or the soul gem in its chest lies open.
charnel_king.tactics: It never moves. Leave the marked lanes and circles, take the gap in each soul ring, then hit the open hand or the soul gem.
